source: Asher Postman 'Future House' (FL demo, stock plugins), effect settings copied into plugins/library with the person's approval (2026-10-25). Each chain is a part's tone chain in the reference's slot order; automation targets (Love Philter, Gross Beat, Balance), meters and Edison are left out because they do nothing without their automation or pump. The chains were tuned for the reference's sounds: they are starting points, so measure the part on a render after a chain goes in and rebalance it (gain-staging), since compressors and saturators change level.

chops.why: light shaping, high-pass 126 Hz with cuts at 300 Hz, 1 kHz and 2.8 kHz and a 5.4 kHz shelf, a 1 s insert reverb at 25%, 5.8:1 compression then multiband, saturation, a cleanup EQ

entries: fh Vocal Chop Fruity Parametric EQ 2
fh Vocal Chop Fruity Multiband Compressor
vocal.why: the reference has no lead vocal: its chop chain without the shaper and saturation, compression before the reverb

fh Grv Kick 18_2 Fruity Multiband Compressor
kick.why: high-pass 35 Hz, cuts at 147 and 396 Hz, a 9.8 kHz lift, gentle three-band control

entries: fh Attack Clap 12 Fruity Parametric EQ 2
clap.why: high-pass 140 Hz, cuts, a 0.4 s room at 32%, saturation

entries: fh Attack Hat 06 Fruity Parametric EQ 2
hats.why: small cuts and a high shelf down, a 0.2 s reverb at 40%

perc.why: high-pass 306 Hz, a ping-pong delay, a 2.1 s reverb

stab.why: cut the low mids, squash hard (22.6:1), a wide 1.5 s reverb at 82%, saturation, a cleanup EQ; the reference's Maximus used as a -10 dB trim is left out (set the level with gain staging)

bass.why: compression 12.7:1, distortion at 71% mix, high-pass 82 Hz, a short room, saturation

sub.why: +6.4 dB at 66 Hz, -9.6 dB at 163 Hz, low-pass 2.4 kHz, heavy compression with +15 dB makeup (rebalance after)

entries: fh Wow Synth Fruity Parametric EQ 2
arp.why: cuts from 171 Hz up, a short reverb with 98 ms predelay, saturation

entries: fh Sidechain FX Fruity Parametric EQ 2
fx.why: bright EQ, a 4.1 s reverb at 75% with dry at 50%, saturation

music_bus.why: the sweepable high-pass (cutoff 0 passes everything) and the throw reverb (wet 0 until a transition raises it); add_transition_automation drives both
